    M

    matches(String) - Method in class entityClasses.LessonsLearned
    Method: boolean matches(String term)
    MAX_CATEGORY - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    A category is a single short label used for grouping and filtering (CS-5).
    MAX_CONTRIBUTOR - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    The contributor is a username, so it uses the same limit usernames use elsewhere.
    MAX_DESCRIPTION - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    The description holds the body of the lesson and is allowed to be long.
    MAX_EMAIL - Static variable in class validation.InputLimits
    The longest email address permitted by the relevant internet standard.
    MAX_INVITATION - Static variable in class validation.InputLimits
    Invitation codes are generated by the application and are short.
    MAX_KEYWORD_COUNT - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    No lesson may carry more keywords than this, so one lesson cannot match every search.
    MAX_KEYWORDS - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    The keywords are a short comma separated list used by the search (CS-4).
    MAX_NAME - Static variable in class validation.InputLimits
    First, middle, last, and preferred names.
    MAX_ONE_KEYWORD - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    No single keyword may be longer than this.
    MAX_PASSWORD - Static variable in class validation.InputLimits
    Passwords are allowed to be longer than usernames, but not unbounded.
    MAX_RESOLUTION - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    The resolution is the reply that resolved the lesson, also allowed to be long.
    MAX_TITLE - Static variable in class validation.LessonInputPolicy
    A title has to be short enough to read at a glance in the list (CS-2).
    MAX_USERNAME - Static variable in class validation.InputLimits
    Usernames are limited to 16 characters, which matches the HW1 recognizer.
